correctness.rationale: Reversing the multiplicative law converts the right brace to a left brace with lambda_g(f)=f(x+g). In characteristic not 2, any g of order below N is excluded from the socle by evaluating lambda_g on x^2, while K x^N acts trivially. Quotienting by K x^N gives the N-1 truncation, proving the complete socle series inductively. The finite-prime maximality bound follows from sizes of strict additive p-group factors.
